records.question: Which types of underwater breathing apparatus does Executive Order No. 002-2001 prohibit for fishing?
records.ground_truth_answer: It prohibits the use of underwater birlathing apparatus: SCUBA, HOOKAH, and REBREATHERS.
ground_truth_chunks: AN ORDER PROHIBITING THE USE OF UNDERWATER BIRLATHING APPARATUS (SCUBA, HOOKAH AND REBREATHERS) FOR FISHING
